Exactly what I hoped and dreamed it would be. Ever since leaving Cleveland for California, I have been very hard pressed to find a place other than Cantor's in LA that can do traditional Kosher deli food. This place was perfect and as on point as you can be. 
I had a single corned beef on rye with mustard and potato pancakes with apple sauce. The single sandwich was gigantic and almost too big to finish (the doubles are absurd). The corned beef was perfectly tender and juicy with a good cured flavor. The potato pancakes were a touch on the greasy side but so delicious that who cares?
My dad had a kosher hot dog which was simple but exactly what he wanted. The other two in our party ordered omelettes and they wished they had split one- super delicious, but again with the huge portions.
Overall I will come back to this place for corned beef every time I'm in Philly.

Very good food and atmosphere ruined by the opposite of what many people here find to be the problem: too long waits.  Instead, we had a reservation, were seated promptly, and had very good food (pepper salad with smoked yoghurt, crab pasta, bluefish on toast, zucchini cake dessert). Barely after putting the last fork of food in our mouths after a course, a server would take our dishes away and then present the next course--or our check, even though we had not even finished the dessert when we received the bill. 

We felt rushed and as though they just wanted to flip the table as soon as they could.  Not a pleasurable experience.
